correctness.rationale: Absolute Fourier summability allows termwise harmonic shifts. For mn>0 and mn<0, Fourier coefficient ratios are H+=1+(aU+bV)/2 and H-=1+(aV+bU)/2. Adding H±≥0 gives a+b≥-4/(U+V), which enforces strictly positive axial and zero coefficients for all r,s in (0,1); Bochner therefore gives necessity/sufficiency of the wedge. At a nonvertex facet one full open mixed quadrant remains positive; successive Vandermonde inversions over distinct x then y show all distinct-site Gram matrices positive, though omitted frequencies preclude universality. At vertex a=b=-2/(U+V), only coordinate-axis Fourier support survives: each site coefficient nullvector has row and column group sums zero, the unoriented incidence matrix of a bipartite graph, with rank V-c and nullity E-V+c. Independent rational check r=1/2,s=1/3 gives U=37/6,V=13/6,a=-6/25, Hx=4/5, Hy=3/5,H0=23/25, and 2×2 grid nullity 1; this does not prove all real parameters.
residual_risks: Requires pairwise distinct torus sites for strict positive definiteness; kernel PSD with duplicates only.
